description: This file defines the UserContext class for the OpenMRS project, representing the current user session, managing authentication, roles, privileges, locales, locations, and user session events.

classes.name: UserContext
classes.description: Manages user session details such as authentication, roles, privileges, location, and locale within the OpenMRS framework.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Authenticates a user with provided credentials and updates the user context accordingly.

methods.name: refreshAuthenticatedUser
methods.description: Refreshes the current user details from the database and updates the user session.

methods.name: becomeUser
methods.description: Switches the current context to another user, given their system ID, used by superusers.

methods.name: getAuthenticatedUser
methods.description: Returns the currently authenticated user, if any.

methods.name: isAuthenticated
methods.description: Checks if there is a currently authenticated user.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the current user and clears session data.

methods.name: addProxyPrivilege
methods.description: Adds a privilege to proxy privileges, allowing temporary elevated access.

methods.name: removeProxyPrivilege
methods.description: Removes a privilege from proxy privileges.

methods.name: setLocale
methods.description: Sets the locale for the current user session.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Returns the current locale for the user session.

methods.name: getAllRoles
methods.description: Returns all roles associated with the current user.

methods.name: getAllRoles (overload)
methods.description: Returns all roles for a specific user, including anonymous and authenticated role if applicable.

methods.name: hasPrivilege
methods.description: Checks if the current user/session has a specified privilege.

methods.name: getAnonymousRole
methods.description: Retrieves the system's anonymous role, caching it for efficiency.

methods.name: getAuthenticatedRole
methods.description: Retrieves the system's authenticated role, caching it for efficiency.

methods.name: getLocationId
methods.description: Returns the location ID associated with the user session.

methods.name: setLocationId
methods.description: Sets the location ID for the user session.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Retrieves the Location object corresponding to the stored location ID.

methods.name: setLocation
methods.description: Sets the user session's location to the provided Location object.

methods.name: setUserLocation
methods.description: Convenience method to set default user location based on user properties.

methods.name: setUserLocale
methods.description: Sets the user locale based on user properties or defaults.

methods.name: getDefaultLocationId
methods.description: Determines the default location ID from user properties, validating existence.

methods.name: notifyPrivilegeListeners
methods.description: Notifies registered PrivilegeListener beans about privilege checks.

methods.name: notifyUserSessionListener
methods.description: Notifies UserSessionListener beans about user login or logout events.
